name: N-acetylcysteine (NAC)
mechanism: Replenishes glutathione to detoxify NAPQI in paracetamol overdose
dosing: IV protocols vary (e.g., 150mg/kg over 1h, then 50mg/kg over 4h, then 100mg/kg over 16h) or oral 72h regimen
monitoring: LFTs, clinical status, anaphylactoid reactions during IV infusion
sideEffects: Anaphylactoid reactions with rapid IV infusion
clinicalPearls: Start empirically if uncertain timing for paracetamol overdose and NAC is available
